prompt: Implement Transfers module in Java 21 records project with command/handler pattern

assertions.name: command_handler_pattern
assertions.description: InitiateTransferCommand implements Command<TransferId>, InitiateTransferHandler implements CommandHandler<InitiateTransferCommand, TransferId>

assertions.name: records_for_value_objects
assertions.description: TransferId is a record (like AccountId), not a class

assertions.name: sealed_event_interface
assertions.description: Transfer has sealed interface Event permits TransferInitiated, TransferCompleted (like Account.Event pattern)

assertions.name: accountid_reused_not_recreated
assertions.description: Uses import from dev.app.banking.accounts.AccountId, does not create new AccountId

assertions.name: amount_reused_not_recreated
assertions.description: Uses import from dev.app.banking.accounts.Amount, does not create new Amount

assertions.name: all_building_blocks_present
assertions.description: All 8 building blocks from DesignDoc have corresponding Java classes

assertions.name: modern_java_features
assertions.description: Uses var declarations, record types, and event records consistent with Java 21 style
